title: Wipeout XL
overview:
- An adrenaline-exploding state, with dopamine already mixed in.
- Power-up items you can feel the love in - the kind that will keep you laughing for days!!!

Feature items:
- Mines, E-Pak, Autopilot, Turbo Boost, Rockets, Missiles, Electro Bolt, Thunder Bomb, Shield, Plasma Bolt, Quake Disruptor.

- These machines apparently float in the air with something called an anti-gravity system. Switch the viewpoint and, if you are unlucky, you might get motion sick. It's that intense.
- Overtake again and again at ultra speed. It's pretty fast, though.

●アドレナリン爆発状態、ドーパミン配合済。
●何日か笑いが止まんない位のヤツとか。愛を感じるパワーアップアイテム!!!

●このマシン、反重力システムというやつで宙に浮いてるらしい。視点変更だと下手したら酔うかも。それくらい。
●ウルトラスピードでまくりまくり。かなり速いけど。
